paras.en: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt- cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared. In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered. Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about. These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the Text 1  daily press. "So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are'."
paras.zh: 我们距离二十世纪之交至第二次世界大战前夕在英国出版的那种不拘一格的报纸评论则更为遥远,那时新闻 纸极其廉价,而时髦的艺术评论被视为刊登它的出版物的一种装饰。在那些遥远的日子里,人们理所当然地 认为主要报纸的评论家会详尽而长篇地撰写他们所报道的事件。这是一项严肃的事业,即使是那些展现学识 时举重若轻的评论家,如George Bernard Shaw和Ernest Newman,也可以信赖他们知道自己在做什么。 这些人相信新闻业是一种使命,并为能在日报上发表文章而自豪。Newman写道:"很少有作者拥有足够的头 脑或足够的文学天赋来在新闻业中保持自己的水准,以至于我忍不住将'新闻业'定义为'不被人阅读的作家用 来贬低被人阅读的作家的一个蔑称'。"

paras.en: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten. Neville Cardus, who wrote for the Manchester Guardian from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket. During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a best-seller. He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored. Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
paras.zh: 不幸的是,这些评论家实际上已被遗忘。Neville Cardus从1917年起为曼彻斯特卫报撰稿,直到1975年去世 前不久,如今他仅仅作为一位撰写板球运动散文的作家为人所知。然而在他的有生之年,他也是英国最重要 的古典音乐评论家之一,其文体广受赞誉,以至于他的《自传》(1947)成为畅销书。他于1967年被授予爵士 头衔,是第一位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。然而,他的著作中现在只有一本还在印行,他关于音乐的大量著述除 了专业人士外已无人知晓。

It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of
forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most
big-city newspapers.
第2段，第1句
本句是 "It is + 形容词 + for sb + to do" 和 "名词 + 关系副词引导的定语从句" 两种典型结构的组
合，都是四六级和考研阅读中的常见句式。形式主语结构和定语从句都是必考语法点，且本句长度
和复杂度与真题接近，掌握后可直接迁移到大量类似句子的理解中，代表性极强。
Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism
published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
第2段，第2句
本句是典型的学术语体长主语结构，主语由中心词加多层介词短语和后置定语修饰，这种模式在四
六级和考研阅读理解中极为常见。"consist of" 表示组成关系也是高频考点。掌握本句的拆解方法
后，可直接迁移到大量同类句子，代表性强。
To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were
once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
第2段，第3句
本句的 to do is to do 结构在四六级和考研阅读中频繁出现,常用于表达抽象的等同或因果关系。同
位语从句解释抽象名词(如 fact / idea / belief)也是真题高频句式,尤其在议论文和说明文中常见。被
动语态 be deemed 加形容词补足语的结构同样是考试重点,类似用法如 be considered / be
regarded / be thought 等在真题中反复考查。整句在长度、嵌套层级、成分配置上都高度贴合考研
英语长难句的典型特征,掌握后可迁移至大量类似句型的理解与翻译。
We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in
England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a
time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an
ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
第3段，第1句
主句包含被动语态谓语、程度状语、复杂介词短语作状语；第一层定语从句包含并列主系表结构和
被动语态，涉及主语补足语的识别；第二层定语从句包含 "介词 + 关系代词" 结构作状语。句中成
分种类丰富（主语、谓语、状语、表语、主语补足语、定语从句），且存在易错点（过去分词短语
作定语与谓语的区分、主语补足语的识别、嵌套定语从句的归属判断），是优质的成分划分训练
材料

In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers
would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
第3段，第2句
综合来看，本句在主干识别和嵌套理解上有适度难度，时态覆盖三种且含被动，成分种类丰富且有
易错点，结构典型性高。对目标学生而言，是一个难度适中、训练价值较高、结构可复用的优质练
习句，值得优先学习。
Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning
lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know
what they were about.
第3段，第3句
句子成分丰富:有物主代词作主语、系表结构、被动谓语、宾语补足语、定语从句、宾语从句、方
式状语等多种成分类型;特别是第二个主句主语部分被定语从句和插入语拉长,适合训练学生在复杂
结构中定位核心成分的能力,练习价值较高。
"So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end
up in journalism," Newman wrote, "that I am tempted to define 'journalism' as 'a
term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are'."
第3段，第5句
成分种类丰富且坑点密集：引语作宾语、结果状语从句、宾语补足语（to define... as...）、定语从
句（包括关系代词作主语）、被动语态中的主谓识别、承前省略的补全。覆盖主谓宾、状语、补
语、定语等多种成分，尤其宾语补足语和定语从句嵌套是高频易错点，训练价值高。
During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England's foremost classical-music
critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a
best-seller.
第4段，第3句
本句包含两个高频考点结构：并列表语（"one of...critics, and a stylist"）和 "so...that..." 结果状语从
句。这两种结构在四六级和考研阅读中频繁出现，掌握后可大量复用。插入性状语和后置定语也是
真题常见句式。整体结构具有很强的代表性。

Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is
unknown save to specialists.
第4段，第5句
本句覆盖了主语、谓语、表语、状语等基本成分，第一个主句的主语结构 "only one of his books"
和第二个主句的主语结构 "his vast body of writings on music" 都包含多层修饰，适合练习识别名
词短语的核心和修饰层次。第二个主句的 "save to specialists" 作为状语，表达让步或例外含义，是
一个相对少见的用法，有一定的练习价值。被动语态的出现也增加了训练价值。

have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
第5段，第3句
并列句加定语从句的组合是考试阅读中的高频句式,过去完成时与一般现在时对比使用体现时间层
次也很常见,in which 引导的定语从句更是经典结构,句式具有较高代表性和复用价值
Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
第5段，第4句
主系表结构加现在完成时是英语考试中常见的句式，主语带后置定语的名词短语也很典型。句首连
接副词的使用符合书面语规范。虽然句子本身较简单，但这种"完成时+系表结构"的组合在阅读理

paras.en: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication": Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else. Marketers have embraced the two-step flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them. The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods. In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention. Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends. Text 3

paras.en: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence – even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others. Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly. For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential. If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.

questions.stem: By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to____

options.A: analyze the consequences of social epidemics.
options.B: discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas.
options.C: exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics.
options.D: describe the essential characteristics of influentials.

questions.analysis:
【判型】By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to 明确问"通过引用某书，作
者意图是"，这是典型的例证/引用目的题。
【拆句】By citing the book The Tipping Point, the author intends to____ 主干是 the author
intends to + 选项动词原形；By citing… 是方式状语，限定意图发生的场合，不是宾语，
别把宾语理解成 the book。
【定位】In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in
large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials,
who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected. The idea is intuitively
compelling, but it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread.
Gladwell 在《引爆点》中主张："社会流行"主要由一小撮特殊个体（influentials，意为有
影响力者）的行动驱动，这些人见多识广、有说服力、人脉广。这个想法直觉上很有吸引
力，但它解释不了思想到底是怎么传播开的。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
A 项把讨论对象换成 consequences of social epidemics（社会流行的后果），但作者
全文聚焦的是"原因/驱动机制"——influentials 是不是驱动力，与"后果"无关。
B)
✓ 正确
driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called
influentials
↔influentials' function in spreading ideas
it doesn't explain how ideas actually spread ↔discuss
预判要的是"借书引入议题"，B 的 discuss influentials' function in spreading ideas
既点出讨论对象（influentials 在传播中的作用），又用 discuss 这一中性词承接作者后
文的反驳——完全匹配。
C)
无中生有
C 项 exemplify people's intuitive response to social epidemics 抓的是 intuitively
compelling 一词，但 intuitively compelling 是作者对 Gladwell 想法的评价，不是
作者想"举例说明 people's intuitive response"——这本书没有被用作"直觉反应"的
例证。
D)
以偏概全
D 项 describe the essential characteristics of influentials 把引此书的目的说成"描述
influentials 的本质特征"。原文虽有 unusually informed, persuasive, or well
connected 几个特征，但作者引此书的目的不是介绍 influentials 是什么人，而是要质
疑"他们到底有没有那么大作用"。

作者认为"两级传播理论"____
A) 可作为营销问题的解决方案。
B) 有助于解释某些流行趋势。
C) 赢得了影响者的支持。
D) 需要可靠证据来证明其有效性。

questions.stem: The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ____

options.A: serves as a solution to marketing problems.
options.B: has helped explain certain prevalent trends.
options.C: has won support from influentials.
options.D: requires solid evidence for its validity.

questions.analysis:
【判型】The author suggests that 中的 suggests 表明问的不是原文直说的话，而是作者通过文本
暗示的态度/判断。
【拆句】The author suggests that the "two-step-flow theory" ____ 是带宾语从句的不完整句，
that 从句的谓语就是四个选项，选项要能与从句主语 the two-step-flow theory 在语法上
接得上。
【定位】The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely
untested theory called the "two-step flow of communication".
influentials 所谓的重要性，源自一种听上去合理但在很大程度上未经检验的理论，被称
为"两级传播"理论。
【选项】A)
过度推断
A 项 serves as a solution to marketing problems。原文 Marketers have embraced
the two-step flow 只是说营销者"拥抱"该理论，并未说它真能"解决"营销问题——拥抱
≠解决。
B)
偷换概念
B 项 has helped explain certain prevalent trends。原文 The theory also seems to
explain the sudden and unexpected popularity——seems to explain（似乎能解
释），核心限定词 seems 表明作者并不认同它真的解释了，B 项把 seems 偷换成 has
helped explain。
C)
无中生有
C 项 has won support from influentials。文章只说营销者（marketers）拥抱该理
论，从未提到 influentials 本身"支持"该理论——influentials 在文中是被研究的对象，
不是支持者。
D)
✓ 正确
largely untested ↔requires solid evidence for its validity
plausible-sounding but largely untested ↔requires solid evidence for its validity
预判要的是"该理论缺乏证据/需要证据"，D 的 requires solid evidence for its validity
恰好是 largely untested 的换说法——同义改写关系最稳，是答案。

[ A ] serves as a solution to marketing problems.
[ B ] has helped explain certain prevalent trends.
[ C ] has won support from influentials.
[ D ] requires solid evidence for its validity.

questions.stem: What the researchers have observed recently shows that____

options.A: the power of influence goes with social interactions.
options.B: interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.
options.C: influentials have more channels to reach the public.
options.D: most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.

questions.analysis:
【判型】What the researchers have observed recently shows that____ 问"研究者观察到的事实
显示什么"，要求对原文研究发现做客观转述。
【拆句】What the researchers have observed recently shows that____ 主句是 What…shows
that____，What 引导的主语从句作 shows 的主语；shows 后才是答案位，别
把"researchers observed"的内容当成答案，要看"该观察揭示了什么"。
【定位】With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose outsize presence is
primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence – even the most influential
members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
除了像 Oprah Winfrey 这样的少数名人——她们的巨大影响力主要靠媒体而非人际互动
——即便是某个群体中最有影响力的人，他们直接互动的对象也并不多。
33. What the researchers have observed recently shows that____
[ A ] the power of influence goes with social interactions.
[ B ] interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media.
[ C ] influentials have more channels to reach the public.
[ D ] most celebrities enjoy wide media attention.

【选项】A)
✓ 正确
even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others
↔the power of influence goes with social interactions
whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence ↔
social interactions
研究者的发现是"影响力的大小 = 人际互动的范围"，A 用 goes with 把这层依存关系直
白说出来——与定位句的论证完全契合。
B)
与原文相反
B 项 interpersonal links can be enhanced through the media。原文是"媒体绕过人
际链条放大名人影响"（outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not
interpersonal），不是说"媒体增强了人际链条"——B 把媒体和人际的关系彻底颠倒。
C)
无中生有
C 项 influentials have more channels to reach the public。研究者的发现恰恰相反
——influentials 接触的人不多。原文从未涉及"渠道多少"的话题，C 凭空给
influentials 添加了"传播渠道更多"的属性。
D)
以偏概全
D 项 most celebrities enjoy wide media attention。原文里 Oprah 是被作为"特例"提
及（With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey），且范围是 a few
celebrities，不是 most celebrities；D 把例外当主张、把"少数"夸成"大多数"。
第4段中带下划线的短语"这些人"指的是那些____的人
A) 处于社会影响网络之外。
B) 与影响源接触很少。
C) 受到影响然后影响他人。
D) 受到最初影响者的影响。

questions.stem: The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who____

options.A: stay outside the network of social influence.
options.B: have little contact with the source of influence.
options.C: are influenced and then influence others.
options.D: are influenced by the initial influential.

questions.analysis:
【判型】The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who____ 问
划线短语指代的对象，是典型的代词/短语指代题，归词义句意类。
【拆句】The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who____ 主
干 the phrase refers to the ones；who 引导定语从句修饰 the ones，选项要能完整接
who，是"那些……的人"。
34. The underlined phrase "these people" in Paragraph 4 refers to the ones who____
[ A ] stay outside the network of social influence.
[ B ] have little contact with the source of influence.
[ C ] are influenced and then influence others.
[ D ] are influenced by the initial influential.

【定位】For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or
her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many
others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
然而要让社会流行真正发生，每个被影响的人必须接着去影响自己的熟人，这些熟人又必须
去影响他们的熟人，如此层层下去；而每一环上的这些人能吸引多少其他人的关注，跟最初
那个 influential 已经没什么关系了。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
A 项 stay outside the network of social influence。these people 恰恰在网络内部、
是传播链上的一环，A 把他们说成"在社会影响网络之外"，与原文相反。
B)
偷换概念
B 项 have little contact with the source of influence。these people 是传播链中的每
一环，他们自己"被影响"过——也就是直接接触过上游的影响源，不是"与影响源接触
少"。B 把"被影响"误读为"几乎没接触"。
C)
✓ 正确
each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances ↔
are influenced and then influence others
who must in turn influence theirs, and so on ↔and then influence others
预判要的就是"被影响且接着影响他人"的双重身份，C 用 are influenced and then
influence others 一句把两动作完整说出来——其他选项要么只说一半，要么完全
偏题。
D)
以偏概全
D 项 are influenced by the initial influential。these people 确实被影响过，但定位
句强调的是他们"继续把影响传下去"这一动作——D 只覆盖"被影响"的一半，丢掉了"再
去影响他人"这一另一半。
社会影响动态中的关键要素是什么?
A) 渴望被接纳。
B) 影响他人的冲动。
C) 乐于接受影响。
D) 依赖他人的倾向。

questions.stem: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?

options.A: The eagerness to be accepted.
options.B: The impulse to influence others.
options.C: The readiness to be influenced.
options.D: The inclination to rely on others.

questions.analysis:
【判型】What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence? 用 What is 直接问
事实性结论，是对末段研究结论的细节定位。
【拆句】What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence? 主干 What is the
essential element；in the dynamics of social influence 是后置介词短语，限定 element
所属的领域，不要把它当成答案的一部分。
35. What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
[ A ] The eagerness to be accepted.
[ B ] The impulse to influence others.
[ C ] The readiness to be influenced.
[ D ] The inclination to rely on others.

【定位】They found that the principal requirement for what is called "global cascades" – the
widespread propagation of influence through networks – is the presence not of a few
influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
他们发现，所谓"全局级传播"——也就是影响力在网络中广泛扩散——的首要条件，不是有
少数 influentials 的存在，而是有一批数量足够的、易被影响的人。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
A 项 The eagerness to be accepted。原文说的是 easily influenced（容易被影
响），不是 eager to be accepted（渴望被接纳）——"被影响"和"被接纳"是两件事，
A 偷换了核心属性。
B)
与原文相反
B 项 The impulse to influence others。原文强调的是"被影响的属性"（被动方），B
说成"影响他人的冲动"（主动方）——方向恰好相反，这正是研究者要否定的
influentials 那一面。
C)
✓ 正确
a critical mass of easily influenced people ↔The readiness to be influenced
the principal requirement ↔the essential element
末段 not A but B 中的 B 就是 easily influenced people 的属性，C 把这个属性抽象为
readiness to be influenced——既不偏，也不强加，是末段结论句的最贴切转述。
D)
过度推断
D 项 The inclination to rely on others。原文只说"易被影响"，不等于"依赖他人"——
被影响是接受信息/态度，依赖他人则涉及生活/情感/决策的更广维度，D 比原文走得
过远。

7 句真题句逐层精讲
下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding
that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally
supposed.
第3段，第1句
覆盖主谓宾、状语、同位语从句、比较从句、被动语态、主语省略等多种成分和结构,且同位语从
句和比较从句的省略还原是易错点,训练价值高

In fact, they don't seem to be required at all.
第3段，第2句
本句的 seem to be + 过去分词结构是四六级和考研阅读中常见的被动表达方式，具有一定典型
性。否定形式和插入语的使用也符合真题句式特点。掌握本句结构后，可迁移到类似的 appear to
be done、tend to be considered 等句型。
The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social
influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose
outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence –
even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that
many others.
第4段，第1句
句中包含主谓宾、主系表两种基本句型,有介词短语作状语、关系代词作定语、插入语、否定结构
等多种成分,第二主句的主语被状语和插入语分隔,是训练抗干扰识别主干的优质例句,且whose引导
的非限制性定语从句是易错考点
Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-
flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends
and colleagues directly.
第4段，第2句
强调句 "it is...who..." 与限制性定语从句的组合是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,既考查强调结构
的识别,又考查定语从句的理解,本句结构高度典型,掌握后可迁移应用到大量类似长难句。
For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then
influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so
on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do
with the initial influential.
第4段，第3句
句子成分丰富且包含多个训练要点:后置定语("so affected"),非限制性定语从句("who must in turn
influence theirs"),主语从句("just how many others pay attention to each of these people"),固定搭
配("pay attention to", "have to do with"),以及情态动词作谓语。覆盖了名词性从句、定语从句、状
语等多种成分,且易错点密集,适合作为划分练习。

If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential
prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or
affect many people.
第4段，第4句
"If 从句，主句" 的真实条件句是四六级和考研阅读中的高频结构。主语带多层后置定语修饰也是学
术文本的典型特征。句子长度和复杂度接近考试真题水平，学习后可直接迁移到同类句型。

questions.analysis:
【判型】Bankers complained that they were forced to____ 把答案锁定在一件具体行为上，不涉
及推断或主旨。
【拆句】Bankers complained that they were forced to____ 是“主句 + that 宾语从句”，从句里用
“were forced to + do”被动结构，空格填动词原形短语；整句无陷阱，关键是 forced to 暗
示“非自愿”。
【定位】Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair.
These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price
managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
银行抱怨说，他们（指准则制定者）的规则迫使银行报告巨额亏损，这很不公平。这些规
则要求银行必须按第三方愿意支付的价格给某些资产估值，而不是管理层和监管者期望的
价格。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay ↔
follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules
预判“被迫执行不利于自己的估值规则”=follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules，
follow=must do、unfavorable=not fair、asset evaluation rules=value assets 的规
则，三处皆同义对齐，故选 A。
B)
偷换概念
collect payments from third parties 把 the price a third party would pay 里仅作“估
值参照”的 third party 偷换成了“第三方付款方”，原文从未说银行真的向第三方收钱。
C)
偷换概念
cooperate with the price managers 凭空造出一个职业身份 the price managers，原
文 the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch 里的 managers 指
银行自己的管理层、不是“定价经理”，更没有合作关系。
D)
答非所问
reevaluate some of their assets 与 value some assets at the price a third party
would pay 看似都涉及“给资产估值”，但题干问的是“被迫做了什么遭抱怨之事”，答案应
是“按某规则估值”，不是“重新估值”这一中性动作。

questions.analysis:
【判型】may result in 表明答案是作者对 FASB 改动后果的判断，文中可能不会原句给出结论，需
要根据立场句推断。
【拆句】the rule changes of the FASB may result in____ 主干 the rule changes may result in
X，of the FASB 是后置定语限定 changes 归属；空格填名词性短语作 result in 的宾语。
【定位】These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in
recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements. Bob Herz, the FASB's
chairman, cried out against those who "question our motives." Yet bank shares rose
and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment
by management."
这些（规则改动）给了银行更多用模型给非流动资产估值的自由，以及在损益表中确认长期
资产损失的更多灵活度。FASB 主席 Bob Herz 怒斥那些“质疑我们动机”的人。然而银行股
价应声上涨，新规增强了某游说团体委婉所称的“管理层的判断权”。
【选项】A)
与原文相反
原文 enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by
management" 明确说管理层判断权被“增强”，the diminishing role of management
恰好与原文相反。
B)
与原文相反
第 2 段 unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the
banking system will be difficult 表明在作者眼中，目前的让步只会让复苏更难，the
revival of the banking system 与作者判断相反。
C)
偷换概念
more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income
statements 谈的是损失“在报表上如何确认”，是会计处理问题；the banks' long-term
asset losses 把规则改动错误地等同为“引发”了银行的长期资产损失。
D)
✓ 正确
the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is
being compromised
↔the weakening of its independence
the use of judgment by management ↔the weakening of its independence
预判“准则制定者独立性被削弱”=the weakening of its independence，its 回指 the

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to____

questions.analysis:
【判型】McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to____ 锁定到 McCreevy 反对的具体行为，是
事实细节，限定 According to Paragraph 4。
【拆句】McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to____ 中 attempt 后接不定式 to do 表“试图做
某事”；空格填动词原形短语，注意 objects to 后的对象是“IASB 的尝试”，反对的是该尝试
本身。
【定位】The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when
it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong. Charlie McCreevy, a European
commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real
world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
IASB 表示自己不想在缺乏总体规划的情况下行动，但等到今年晚些时候完成规则重构时，
让其屈服的压力将很大。欧洲委员 Charlie McCreevy 警告 IASB，它不是“生活在政治真空
中”，而是“生活在现实世界里”，且欧洲可能另起一套规则。
【选项】A)
张冠李戴
keep away from political influences 是 not live in a political vacuum 的同义陈述，
但这恰恰是 McCreevy 警告 IASB 不能做的事，不是 IASB 自己 attempt to 做的事；题
干问的是 McCreevy 反对 IASB 想做什么。
B)
无中生有
evade the pressure from their peers 中的 peers（同行）在原文找不到对应——压力
来自欧洲部长与委员会，是政治/监管压力，不是“同行压力”。
C)
✓ 正确
it does not want to act without overall planning ↔act on their own in rule-setting
not live in a political vacuum ↔act on their own in rule-setting
预判“反对 IASB 不顾政治现实、按自己节奏出规则”=act on their own in rule-
setting：on their own 抓住“独自”这一核心，与 McCreevy “你不在真空里”的反讽完全
对位。
D)
无中生有
take gradual measures in reform 谈“渐进改革”，原文 IASB 的表态是“要总体规划再
动”而非“分步走”；gradual 在原文无对应。

questions.stem: The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they____

options.A: misinterpreted market price indicators.
options.B: exaggerated the real value of their assets.
options.C: neglected the likely existence of bad debts.
options.D: denied booking losses in their sale of assets.

questions.analysis:
【判型】in that they____ 是因果连词 in that，要求从形象句推出作者所指的实际事实，答案是对原
句的解释性同义替换。
【拆句】The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they____ 主干 The
author thinks (that) the banks were ...；in that 是因果连词，相当于 because；空格填
动词短语解释“为何错”。
【定位】It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.
走错了星球的恰恰是银行——他们的账目上严重高估了资产。
【选项】A)
答非所问
misinterpreted market price indicators 对应的是 they argue that market prices
overstate losses——这是银行如今为自己辩解的话，而非作者用来论证 banks were
on the wrong planet 的依据；题干问的是“为什么走错星球”，不是“银行如今怎么
辩护”。
B)
✓ 正确
with accounts that vastly overvalued assets ↔exaggerated the real value of their assets
预判“严重高估资产”=exaggerated the real value of their assets：exaggerated 对应
overvalued，real value of their assets 对应 accounts 高估的对象，正向一一对位。
C)
过度推断
原文 not the likely extent of bad debts 只说银行如今认为市价不能反映坏账规模，没
有说银行“忽视坏账的存在”；neglected the likely existence of bad debts 把 the
extent of（规模）偷换为 the existence of（存在与否），并把原本的 likely extent 抽
象成完全忽视，过度推断。
D)
答非所问
denied booking losses in their sale of assets 对应 banks which will not sell assets
for fear of booking losses——这是文章对当前市场停滞的解释，发生在“走错星球”之
后，与题干问的原因属于不同时间线。

[ A ] misinterpreted market price indicators.
[ B ] exaggerated the real value of their assets.
[ C ] neglected the likely existence of bad debts.
[ D ] denied booking losses in their sale of assets.

与原文相反
satisfaction 要求作者对 standard-setters 当前状况感到满意，但 is being
compromised 与 inviting pressure to make more concessions 都是负面处境描述，

B)
张冠李戴
skepticism 要求作者对 standard-setters 的能力或动机存疑，但 cleaning up rules on

是明显的赞许；作者怀疑的是“让步会带来更多让步”的趋势，并非怀疑对象本身。
C)

combative standard-setters 都明显站在 standard-setters 一边，并对其当下让步明
确表达忧虑——这是带立场的同情，非客观中立。
D)
✓ 正确
the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is
being compromised
↔sympathy
by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions ↔sympathy
预判“认可对象、惋惜其处境”=sympathy：作者既高声肯定 independent and even
combative standard-setters 的价值，又为其在压力下被迫让步而抱憾，整体语气与“同
情”最贴。

下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.
第1段，第1句
简单句搭配现在完成进行时在考试中较为常见，反身代词作宾语和介词短语作状语也是典型用法，
具有一定代表性，但结构本身过于简单，不如含从句的复杂句式更具迁移价值。
And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the
banking system will be difficult.
第2段，第3句
本句的结构是典型的条件句（主句 + unless 引导的状语从句），且状语从句内部嵌套定语从句修
饰名词，这种多层修饰的条件句在四六级和考研阅读中经常出现。动名词短语作主语、系动词加表
语的主句结构也是常考句型。学习者掌握本句的分析方法后，可以迁移到大量类似的条件句和定语
从句结构上，代表性较高。
The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to
fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
第4段，第2句
并列转折句、宾语从句、时间状语从句、长主语结构都是四六级和考研真题中高频出现的句式。特
别是 "but" 连接两个对立观点的并列结构,以及主语被后置定语拉长的模式,在真题阅读中极为常见,
代表性强。
It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued
assets.
第5段，第1句
强调句"It is/was...that"是四六级和考研阅读的高频句式,with引导的伴随状语和that引导的限制性定
语从句也是常考结构,本句将三者组合在一起,非常接近真题中常见的复杂句模式,学习后可直接迁移
到大量类似句子

And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for
fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
第5段，第5句
本句涵盖了主谓宾、定语从句、并列谓语、状语(程度状语 "partly"、原因状语 "for fear of...")、宾
语等多种成分,成分种类较为丰富。定语从句的识别(通过 "which" 引导)、并列谓语的划分(通过
"yet" 连接)、原因状语的辨认("for fear of" 结构)都是常考且易错的点。此外,"are reluctant to buy"
中的不定式短语作宾语,也是值得练习的结构。整体来看,这句话作为成分划分练习材料,能覆盖多个
实用知识点。
America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets
to levels which buyers find attractive.
第6段，第2句
本句成分丰富且有代表性：主句涵盖主语（带多层修饰）、谓语、条件状语；条件从句涵盖主语、
谓语、宾语、程度状语；定语从句涵盖关系代词作宾语、主语、谓语、宾语补足语。特别是定语从
句中关系代词 "which" 在从句内充当宾语（而非主语）是易错点，"find + 宾语 + 宾补" 结构也值得
练习。此外不定式作后置定语、unless 引导的条件状语从句都是常考点。唯一不足是缺少被动语态
或复杂时态，但仍是一个很好的成分划分练习句。
But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more
concessions.
第6段，第5句
简单句结构 "主语 + 谓语 + 宾语"，搭配句首介词短语作状语和名词后不定式作定语，是四六级和
考研阅读中非常常见的句式。这种 "状语前置 + 核心主干 + 后置定语" 的组合在真题中高频出现，
学习后可迁移到大量类似句子，典型性较高。

options.A: The first and most important is the consumer's growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005. This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent. Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious. They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative. 首要且最重要的因素是消费者日益增长的外出就餐偏好：在家庭以外场所的食品和饮料消费已从 1995年占总消费的约32%上升到2000年的35%，预计到2005年将接近38%。这一发展趋势正在推 动整个欧洲餐饮服务领域的批发需求以每年4%至5%的速度增长，相比之下零售需求的增长率为1% 至2%。与此同时，随着经济衰退迫在眉睫,人们变得焦虑不安。他们倾向于更紧地捂住钱包，并将 在家就餐视为一种现实的选择。
options.B: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe's largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow. Most leading retailers have already tried e- commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad. But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need. 欧洲最大市场的食品和饮料零售销售处于停滞状态，使得欧洲食品杂货零售商渴望获得增长机会。 大多数领先零售商已经尝试过电子商务，但成效有限，也尝试过海外扩张。但几乎所有零售商都忽 视了自家后院的一个巨大且利润丰厚的机会：食品和饮料批发贸易，这似乎正是零售商所需要的那 种市场。
options.C: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market? Definitely not. The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers. In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy. partC.analysis:
逐句解析
句前 (N) 即考卷划线句题号，与卷面下划线句一一对应——满分 10 分、每句约 2 分，阅卷把每句切成意群按采
分点给分（★ 为采分点意群）。
【来源】美国生态学家阿尔多·利奥帕德(Aldo Leopold)的著作 A Sand County Almanac《沙乡
年鉴》。
【主旨】批判只看经济价值的自然保护观
全文核心立场是：One basic weakness in a conservation system based wholly on economic
motives is that most members of the land community have no economic value. 作者认为只
用经济动机来衡量自然保护是根本性缺陷，主张土地共同体（land community）中无经济价值的
成员同样有存续权；语调批判中带反思，到结尾 a system of conservation based solely on
economic self-interest is hopelessly lopsided. 进一步盖章定性为"严重失衡"。
killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
(49)In Europe, where forestry
is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native
forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason.
(50)It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack
commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning.

【指代】them / they 多次指代鸟、捕食动物等
46 句的 if birds failed to control them 中的 them 不能孤立译成"它们"，需回上文 insects
would eat us up，定为"昆虫"；48 句 they prey only on "worthless" species 的 they 须回到
predatory mammals and fish-eating birds，定为"这些捕食动物"。
its / itself 指 land community 或 game
50 句 essential to its healthy functioning 的 its 须回到本句 many elements in the land
community 中的 the land community，译作"土地共同体的"；48 句 the health of game 中的
game 是"猎物（野生动物）"的熟词僻义，不是"游戏"。
land community / biotic community 全篇统一术语
they are entitled to continuance 之前出现的 the land community 与 the biotic community
是贯穿全文的核心术语，全篇统一译作"土地共同体""生物共同体"，46–50 各句出现时不要换译
法，避免术语漂移。
(46) Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects
would eat us up if birds failed to control them.
【意群】Scientists jumped to the rescue（主干 主谓）★采分→科学家们跳出来救援
难点：jump to the rescue 是固定搭配
Scientists jumped to the rescue 中 jump to the rescue 不是字面"跳着去救"，是"赶忙出手相
助、紧急驰援"的习语；结合上文 songbirds were supposed to be disappearing，语境是科学
家"赶紧出来为鸣禽辩护"。
with some distinctly shaky evidence（方式状语（介词短语））★采分→带着一些明显站不住脚
的证据
难点：shaky 的态度色彩
some distinctly shaky evidence 里 shaky 字面"摇晃的"，此处熟词僻义为"靠不住的、站不住
脚的"；distinctly 译"明显地"，整体带作者的负面评价，呼应全文 It is painful to read these
roundabout accounts today. 的批判口吻，不能轻飘飘译成"一些证据"。
to the effect that insects would eat us up（evidence 的同位语从句（由 to the effect that 引出））
★采分→其大意是：昆虫会把我们吃光
难点：to the effect that 是同位语连接词
to the effect that insects would eat us up 中 to the effect that 等于 "meaning that / 大
意是"，引出 evidence 的具体内容；eat us up 不是字面"把人吃掉"，结合主语 insects 应理
解为"（虫害）把我们的庄稼/家底蚕食殆尽"，可处理为"会把我们吃光"或"会把我们的农作物
吃光"。
if birds failed to control them.（条件状语从句）★采分→如果鸟类不能控制它们
难点：them 的回指还原
if birds failed to control them 中 them 不能直接译"它们"，要回到前一块 insects would eat
us up 还原为"昆虫"，否则汉语读者读不出指代；fail to do 译"未能/不能"比"失败做"更顺。

【调序】方式状语前置 + 同位语拆成冒号句
本句结构 Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect
that… 在英文里方式状语 with… 在主谓之后，符合汉语习惯可直接顺译"科学家们……拿出了……证
据"；同位语从句 to the effect that 引导的内容较长，按汉语习惯拆出，用冒号或破折号衔接
成"大意是：……"；条件状语 if birds failed to control them 按汉语"如果……就……"前置，但因主
句已含"虫害会吃光我们"的判断，仍可顺写为"如果鸟类不加以控制"。
【译文】科学家们赶忙出来救场，拿出了一些明显站不住脚的证据，大意是：如果鸟类不能控
制昆虫，昆虫就会把我们吃光。
(47) but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a
matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.
【意群】but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting（主干 主谓（含转折 but））★采分→但
我们至少已经更接近承认这一点
难点：draw nearer the point of doing 的转译
we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting 直译"我们已被拉近到承认……的地
步"非常翻译腔；按汉语习惯转成"我们至少已经更接近于承认……"或"我们至少已经开始愿意承
认……"；at least 体现作者的让步语气，要保留"至少"。
that birds should continue（admitting 的宾语从句主干）★采分→鸟类应当继续存在
难点：continue 的语境取义
birds should continue 中 continue 不要译"继续"那么空，结合上文 they are entitled to
continuance 锚定为"继续存在、存续下去"，呼应全文"存续权"的主线。
as a matter of intrinsic right,（方式状语（介词短语））★采分→作为一种内在的权利
难点：as a matter of 的固定译法
as a matter of intrinsic right 中 as a matter of 是固定结构，意思"作为……的事情、出
于……"；intrinsic right 译"固有权利/内在权利/自身的权利"均可，是本句核心采分概念，不能
漏译"intrinsic"这个修饰。
regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.（让步状语（介词短语））★
采分→无论对我们是否存在经济利益
难点：presence or absence 抽象名词具体化
regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us 直译"经济利益的存在
或缺席"很僵；把抽象名词 presence/absence 还原成动作"有/没有"，译"不管对我们有没有经济
利益"或"无论是否对我们具有经济价值"。to us 表"对我们而言"，不能丢。
【调序】宾语从句顺译 + 让步状语提前可选
本句 but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue
as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of… 整体顺译即可：主句→that 宾语从句→方式状语→
让步状语；唯一调整是 regardless of… 这一较长让步状语，按汉语习惯也可前置成"无论……，鸟
类都应当……"，但本句因主从清晰，保留尾随更自然。
【译文】但我们至少已经更接近于承认这一点：鸟类应当作为一种固有的权利继续存在下去，
无论它们对我们是否具有经济价值。

(48) Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the
health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
【意群】Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence（主干（Time was when… 倒装句
型））★采分→曾经有一段时间，生物学家有些过度使用了这一证据
难点：Time was when 是固定句型
Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence 中 Time was when… 等于
"There was a time when…"，固定译"曾经有一段时间……"；overwork 不是"过度工作"，在此
熟词僻义为"过度使用、滥用"；somewhat 是程度副词，译"有些、多少有点"，不可丢——它是
作者的委婉批评。
that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak,（evidence 的同
位语从句①）★采分→这些动物通过杀掉体弱者来维持猎物种群的健康
难点：these creatures、game、physically weak 三个回指/僻义
these creatures 须回到段首 predatory mammals and fish-eating birds，译"这些猎食性
动物"或"这些捕食动物"；game 在此熟词僻义为"猎物（被捕食的野生动物）"，绝不是"游
戏"——是本句最阴的盲区；the physically weak 是"the + 形容词"表一类人/物，译"体弱的
（个体）"。
or that they prey only on "worthless" species.（evidence 的同位语从句②（与上句并列））★采分
→或者它们只捕食那些"无价值的"物种
难点：they 回指 + worthless 引号
they prey only on "worthless" species 中 they 同样回指 predatory mammals and fish-
eating birds，可重复译为"这些捕食动物"或承前省作"它们"；"worthless" 加引号是作者反讽，
译文要保留中文引号"无价值的"或"所谓无价值的"，体现态度；only 译"只"，限定范围不能丢。
【调序】同位语用冒号拆 + by 状语前置
本句 the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically
weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species 若按"……的证据"翻成长定语会非常拗口；
按汉语习惯把 evidence 译完后用冒号或破折号引出两个同位语内容，处理为"过度运用了这样的证
据：其一……，其二……"或"过度强调以下证据：……，或者……"。by killing the physically weak
是方式状语，按汉语习惯前置到动词前，译"通过杀掉体弱者来维持……"。
【译文】曾经有一段时间，生物学家有些过度地使用这样的证据：他们认为这些动物通过捕杀
体弱的个体来维持猎物种群的健康，或者它们只捕食那些"无价值的"物种。

(49) In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are
recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason.
【意群】In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced,（地点状语 + 非限制性定语从句）★采
分→在欧洲，那里的林业在生态学上更先进
难点：where 非限制性定语从句的处理
In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, 中 where 引导非限制性定语，按
汉语习惯不能硬译成"……的欧洲"的前置长定语；拆成并列句"在欧洲，那里的林业在生态学上更
为先进"或独立小句"欧洲的林业在生态层面更先进，在那里……"；ecologically 译"在生态（学）
上、从生态角度"，是采分细节。
the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community,
（主干 主谓（被动））★采分→无商业价值的树种被承认为本土森林共同体的成员
难点：被动语态汉化 + 关键术语
the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest
community 是 are recognized as 被动结构；汉译可保留"被承认为"，或转主动"（人们）
将……视为/承认为"；noncommercial="无商业价值的、非商业性的"，呼应上文 economics-
minded foresters 与 too low a sale value to pay as timber crops；the native forest
community 与全文术语 the biotic community 保持一致，统一译"本土森林共同体"。
to be preserved as such,（目的/补充状语（不定式被动））★采分→并以这样的身份得到保护
难点：as such 的指代回还
to be preserved as such 中 as such 不是"如此"那么飘，它回指上一块的"成员"身份——意思
是"作为（共同体的）成员而得到保护"，可译"并以这样的身份/作为这样的成员而得到保护"；to
be preserved 是被动不定式，转主动可作"加以保护"。
within reason.（范围状语）★采分→在合理的范围内
难点：within reason 是固定搭配
within reason. 中 within reason 是固定短语"在合理范围内、有分寸地"，不是"在理由之内"；
它收束整句、给"保护"加一个范围限定，避免被理解为"无条件保护"。
【调序】where 从句拆并列 + 被动转主动可选 + as such/within reason 收尾分句化
本句 In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree
species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as
such, within reason. 调序两步：① where 非限制性定语从句拆开译为并列小句"在欧洲，那里的
林业……"，避免前置长定语；② 句尾 to be preserved as such, within reason 拆成独立短句"并
以这样的身份得到合理范围内的保护"或"并在合理范围内受到这样的保护"，让汉语句子有节奏感，
不堆在一起。
【译文】在欧洲，那里的林业在生态层面更为先进，无商业价值的树种被视为本土森林共同体
的成员，并以这样的身份在合理的范围内得到保护。

(50) It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that
lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning.
【意群】It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate,（主干 主谓（含插入并列谓语））★采分→它
往往忽视，并因而最终消灭
难点：It 回指 + 并列谓语夹注
It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements… 中 It 必须回到上句 a
system of conservation based solely on economic self-interest，还原为"这种（完全基于经
济自利的）保护体系"或承前简译"它/这种体系"；ignore 与 eliminate 是两个并列谓语，被两个
逗号夹成"插入"形式，汉译要让它们都接到同一个宾语 many elements 上，常用"往往忽视……
乃至最终消灭"或"忽视并因而最终消灭"。
many elements in the land community（宾语（含 in 介词短语作后置定语））★采分→土地共同体
中的许多成分
难点：the land community 术语统一
many elements in the land community 中 the land community 是贯穿全文的核心术语，全
篇统一译"土地共同体"；elements 在生态语境中译"成分/要素/成员"均可，本句指构成土地共同
体的物种与组成部分。
that lack commercial value,（限制性定语从句①（修饰 elements））★采分→缺乏商业价值
难点：lack 译法
that lack commercial value 中 lack 是动词"缺乏、没有"；commercial value 译"商业价值/经
济价值"，与全文 economic self-interest 主线呼应——这是被作者反对的衡量尺度。
but that are essential to its healthy functioning.（限制性定语从句②（与①并列，转折））★采分→
但对其健康运转必不可少
难点：its 回指 + healthy functioning 抽象名词具体化
essential to its healthy functioning 中 its 须回到本句 the land community，译"土地共同体
的"，绝不要留"它的"在汉语里飘；healthy functioning 是抽象名词短语，具体化为"健康运转/
正常运转"，比直译"健康的功能化"自然得多。
【调序】插入语回填 + 两个定语从句拆并列分句
本句 It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land
community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning. 调
序两步：① 把插入语 and thus eventually to eliminate 回填到主句，组成"往往忽视乃至最终消
灭土地共同体中的许多成分"；② 两个 that 引导的并列定语从句较长且有转折 but，按汉语习惯不
再前置成"缺乏商业价值但对……必不可少的许多成分"，而是拆成并列小句"这些成分虽然缺乏商业
价值，但对土地共同体的健康运转却必不可少"。
【译文】这种体系往往会忽视、并因此最终消灭土地共同体中的许多成分——这些成分虽然缺
乏商业价值，但对土地共同体的健康运转却至关重要。

9 句真题句逐层精讲

下列真题句各有独立的句子解析页——中文翻译、结构树逐层拆解、成分与时态、考点讲
解与真题高频词。点击句子进入完整解析。
Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect
that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them.
第2段，第3句
句子包含同位语从句和条件状语从句，这两种从句都是四六级和考研阅读中的高频结构。同位语从
句用 to the effect that 引出，是学术文本中常见的表达方式。整体句式（主句 + 同位语从句 + 嵌
套状语从句）是考试阅读中的典型长难句模式，学会分析此句可迁移到大量类似句型。
It is painful to read these roundabout accounts today.
第3段，第1句
It is + 形容词 + to do 是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式，用于表达对某一行为或情况的评价。这
一结构在真题中反复出现，掌握后可迁移到大量类似句子，典型性较高。
It is only in recent years that we hear the more honest argument that predators are
members of the community, and that no special interest has the right to
exterminate them for the sake of benefit, real or fancied, to itself.
第4段，第4句
这句结构层级丰富、训练点集中，而时态本身不太难，适合把注意力放在“如何拆结构、找主干”
上。作为结构与时态综合训练材料，优先级很高。
Some species of trees have been "read out of the party" by economics-minded
foresters because they grow too slowly, or have too low a sale value to pay as
timber crops.
第5段，第1句
现在完成时被动语态加原因状语从句的组合是四六级和考研阅读中的高频句式,被动语态表达学术
客观性、原因从句解释现象成因,都是典型的学术语言特征,掌握后可广泛迁移。

In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree
species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved
as such, within reason.
第5段，第2句
高度典型的四六级阅读句式：被动语态主句配合插入式非限制性定语从句，地点状语前置，不定式
短语作目的状语，这种结构在学术类文章和考试阅读中频繁出现，掌握后可迁移到大量同类句型，
代表性强。
Moreover, some have been found to have a valuable function in building up soil

The interdependence of the forest and its constituent tree species, ground flora,

语"的多层修饰组合具有较强的代表性，学生掌握后可迁移到大量同类句子

It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land

英语一真题(2010)
Directions:
You are supposed to write for the Postgraduates’ Association a notice to recruit volunteers for an
international conference on globalization. The notice should include the basic qualifications for applicants
and the other information which you think is relevant.
You should write about 100 words on ANSWER SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the notice. Use “Postgraduates’ Association” instead. (10
points)
【参考范文 · 98 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Notice June 20, 2026
The Postgraduates' Association is now recruiting volunteers for an upcoming international conference on
globalization, which will bring together scholars from around the world. Applicants are expected to meet the
following basic qualifications: fluent English for communication with foreign guests, a background related to
economics or international relations, and enough free time during the conference week.
The conference will be held from July 10 to 12 in the main hall. Those interested should send a brief
application to pa@university.edu before June 30. For more information, please feel free to contact us at
010-12345678.
Postgraduates' Association
【参考译文】
通知 2026 年 6 月 20 日
研究生会现为一场即将举办的全球化国际会议招募志愿者，本次会议将汇聚来自世界各地的学者。申请者
须满足以下基本资格：英语流利、能与外宾沟通，具备经济学或国际关系相关的专业背景，并在会议期间
有充足的空闲时间。

会议将于 7 月 10 日至 12 日在主厅举行。有意者请于 6 月 30 日前将一份简短的申请发送至
pa@university.edu。如需了解更多信息，欢迎拨打 010-12345678 与我们联系。
研究生会
【第 1 段】标题日期就位。Notice 单列居中、下写日期，落实了 outline 第一块‘标题与日期’，让人一眼
看出是通知而非书信。
【第 2 段】目的加资格一段清。开头 is now recruiting volunteers... 点明招募目的，随后 Applicants
are expected to meet the following basic qualifications: 用三项并列把资格列全，落实the basic
qualifications for applicants。
【第 3 段】其他信息全给到。The conference will be held...、Those interested should send... before
June 30、please feel free to contact us at... 三句把时间地点、报名截止、联系方式补齐，覆盖the
other information which you think is relevant。
【第 4 段】机构落款守住。结尾以 Postgraduates' Association 落款、未署真名，守住Use
“Postgraduates’ Association” instead这条硬性要求。
A N A L Y S I S · 审题与立意
这道题到底要写什么、立意是什么
动笔前先钉死本题的核心写作任务与读者语域 ，再定中心立意与要展开的要点 —— 这些
是本题特有的内容判断，不是通用套路。
核心任务
招募会议志愿者的通知
本题要写一则通知，recruit volunteers for an international conference on globalization，核心
交际目的是把‘谁能报、怎么报’讲清楚，让合格的研究生前来担任志愿者。
读者 · 语域
面向研究生公众的正式通知
以研究生会名义发布——write for the Postgraduates’ Association a notice，读者是全体潜在报
名者，语域正式客观、用第三人称；落款有硬性要求：Do not sign your own name at the end
of the notice. Use “Postgraduates’ Association” instead。

中心立意
让合格研究生知道如何报名当志愿者
本通知的交际目的：为全球化国际会议招募志愿者，说清the basic qualifications for applicants
与the other information which you think is relevant，使符合条件者能顺利报名。
要展开的要点
1. 基本资格条件
对应the basic qualifications for applicants：英语沟通能力、经济或国际关系相关专业背景、会
议期间有空闲时间。
2. 会议基本信息
属于the other information which you think is relevant的一部分：会议主题（全球化）、时间与
地点。
3. 报名方式与截止、联系方式
同属其他相关信息：怎么报名、报名截止日期、咨询用的联系方式。
S T R U C T U R E · 谋篇与逐段
怎么分段、每段写什么、能套哪些句架
按写作家族给出现成的段落框架（每段承担什么功能），并为每段配可直接套用的 功能
句架（留出填本题内容的空位）。段序与上方参考范文一一对应。
第 1 段
标题与日期
顶部居中写 Notice，下一行可写发布日期，让读者一眼认出这是通知而非书信。
第 2 段
目的＋资格
开门见山说明为an international conference on globalization招募志愿者，并列出基本资
格。
第 3 段
会议信息＋报名＋联系
交代会议时间地点、报名方式、截止日期与联系方式，即the other information which
you think is relevant。

第 4 段
落款

第 1 段
标题Notice与日期

标题

日期
· 写在标题下方：Month Day, Year

背景、会议期间有空闲时间。

[条件2], and [条件3].

给时间地点

研究生会落款

两块任务点全覆盖
须写全the basic qualifications for applicants和the other information which you think
is relevant，本题最易漏的是报名方式、截止日与联系方式这几项其他信息。

资格与办事信息分段
资格放一段、会议与报名信息放一段，中间用并列或顺序衔接，避免堆成一大段混在

英语一真题(2010)
Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should
1)describe the drawing briefly,
2)explain its intended meaning, and
3)give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)

【参考范文 · 173 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, a steaming hotpot is boiling on the table, in which various ingredients are
cooking. Each ingredient is labeled with a cultural name, such as Confucianism, Taoism, Peking Opera and
Kung Fu from China, along with Shakespeare, Einstein, Swan Lake and Enlightenment from the West. Above
it reads a title: "Cultural hotpot, both delicious and nutritious."
Simple as it looks, the drawing conveys a thought-provoking message about cultural integration. The hotpot,
which blends ingredients of different origins into one delicious dish, symbolizes an open and inclusive culture
that absorbs the essence of both domestic and foreign traditions. Just as a hotpot tastes better when more
ingredients are added, a culture grows richer when it embraces diverse elements rather than rejecting them. In
an era of globalization, no culture can thrive in isolation.

In my view, such cultural inclusiveness deserves our applause. We should keep an open mind, learning from
other cultures while preserving our own roots. Only in this way can our culture stay nutritious and appealing.
【参考译文】
正如漫画生动描绘的那样，桌上一口火锅正咕嘟冒着热气，锅里煮着各式各样的食材。每样食材都被标上
了一个文化名称——来自中国的有儒、道、京剧、功夫，来自西方的有莎士比亚、爱因斯坦、天鹅湖、启
蒙。火锅上方写着标题：“文化火锅，既美味又营养”。
画面看似简单，却传递出一个发人深省的关于文化融合的信息。这口把不同来源的食材融成一道美味的火
锅，象征着一种开放包容、能够吸纳中外传统精华的文化。正如火锅里食材越多越鲜美，一种文化在接纳
多元元素而非排斥它们时，也会变得更加丰富。在全球化时代，没有哪种文化能够孤立地繁荣。
在我看来，这种文化包容值得称赞。我们应保持开放的心态，既向其他文化学习，又守护自身的根脉。唯
有如此，我们的文化才能始终富有营养、充满魅力。
【第 1 段】套句总起加克制罗列。本段用 "As is vividly depicted in the cartoon" 一句总起点出火锅
主体，再以 "Each ingredient is labeled with a cultural name, such as..." 各举两三个中西例子，末句
带出画中标题，落实描述段'总起＋两三处关键细节'的方法，完成 describe the drawing briefly 且篇幅
克制。
【第 2 段】象征加类比把寓意说透。本段用 "symbolizes an open and inclusive culture" 把火锅意象绑
定到文化融合，再以 "Just as a hotpot tastes better when more ingredients are added" 的类比坐实
